crucialFeats: Picks up and slams down a Y-Wing bomber.
Slams two starships together with telekinesis.
Impales himself to kill the reborn Darth Maul.
Blocks an energy blast with his hand.
Survives a giant explosion that destroys a casino.

dossier.advantage: Elite precision and an iron defense. His mastery of the Force allows him to control the environment and the enemy's body, preventing effective counterattacks.
dossier.mentality: Cold, patient, and ruthless. He waits for the smallest mistake from the opponent to end the fight with a single, vengeful strike.
dossier.quote: All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men.
dossier.style: Technical pressure fighting with the Force. He combines perfect lightsaber swordsmanship with brutal telekinesis to choke and crush opponents in close quarters.

fighterA.name: Darth Vader

powers: Force telekinesis, precognition, choke and crush techniques, and elite lightsaber lethality.
tools: Defensive saber discipline, blaster and energy deflection, and Force-based battlefield control.
weaknesses: Cybernetic life-support dependence and vulnerability to sustained system disruption.
Lower raw physical durability and scale than top cosmic entities.

crucialFeats: Destroys a planet during a fight with Drax.
Walks out of a gas-giant explosion unharmed.

dossier.advantage: Near-absolute invulnerability and tactical genius. He possesses a body capable of surviving attacks from gods and a mind that instantly turns an enemy's mistake into their inevitable defeat.
dossier.mentality: Arrogant nihilist with iron discipline. He fights with absolute certainty of his superiority, seeking to ruthlessly crush anyone who stands in his way.
dossier.quote: I did not force you to fight me. You forced me into doing what I did. I had to be faithful to my nature. For, after all, I am Thanos.
dossier.style: Brutal, precise powerhouse combat. Thanos combines mastery of hand-to-hand combat with devastating cosmic energy blasts to systematically crush any defense.

fighterB.name: Thanos

powers: Massive strength and durability, cosmic energy projection, force fields, and matter manipulation.
tools: Strategic intellect, combat adaptability, and broad resistance profile.
weaknesses: Arrogance and tendency to test opponents can create early openings.
Without Infinity Stones, he remains elite but lacks Gauntlet-level instant authority.

victories: Beta Ray Bill and Ronan the Accuser

battle-dynamics.phase_1: Vader enters a state of absolute fury. The Dark Side fuels his cybernetics, making his initial lightsaber strikes extremely dangerous.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Thanos faces unprecedented aggression. He must use force fields to endure a storm of blows that could cut through smaller stars.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Despite the rage, Thanos's scale takes over. Vader exhausts his Force reserves while the Titan is only beginning his counterattack.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Force Rage gives Vader the tools to wound Thanos, but it doesn't change the fundamental durability gap.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Vader fights technically, relying on precognition. Thanos calmly analyzes the Sith Lord's fighting style.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Without the fury, Thanos takes the initiative faster. His cosmic energy begins to corrode Vader's defense.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Vader is forced into deep defense. Thanos dominates the battlefield through his sheer physical presence.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: Without extreme Force augmentation, Vader has no way to break the Titan's armor.
battle-dynamics.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Force Rage
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_1: Vader goes all in. He attempts to crush Thanos's internal organs with telekinesis in the first second.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_2: Thanos survives the bypass and responds with brutal strength. The fight becomes a slaughter where Vader's armor cracks.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_3: The Sith's last breath. Vader tries to take Thanos to the grave with him, but the Titan stands unmoved.
battle-dynamics.s3_analysis: Death rules eliminate the chance for a technical KO, which is a death sentence for Vader.
battle-dynamics.s4_label: Fight to the Death · No Rage
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_1: Vader tries to maintain distance, but Thanos simply walks through him, ignoring saber thrusts.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_2: Every Thanos counterstrike is devastating to Vader's life-support systems.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_3: Thanos ends the fight by crushing Vader's helmet with bare hands. Zero symmetry.
battle-dynamics.s4_analysis: The most one-sided scenario. Thanos dominates every aspect of cosmic scale.

fight-simulation.opening: Vader erupts with dark energy, immediately closing the distance to Thanos.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Thanos blocks the lightsaber with his gauntlets, generating cosmic discharges.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Vader weakens from Force exhaustion, allowing Thanos to land a decisive blow.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Thanos's victory through pure durability advantage in a prolonged exchange.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Vader rains blows down on Thanos, forcing the Titan to take a step back.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: The lightsaber cuts through Thanos's force fields in a blinding glow.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Vader finds a gap and wounds Thanos in the shoulder.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Thanos counters with an energy blast from his palm.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Thanos delivers a series of strikes that Vader's armor cannot absorb.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Vader desperately tries to push Thanos back with telekinesis.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Vader fights defensively, looking for weak points in Thanos's stance.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Rapid exchanges where Vader relies solely on technique.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Thanos loses patience and moves to the offensive.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_b: Vader maintains distance with his lightsaber.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Thanos simply grabs the lightsaber blade (via force field) and tosses Vader aside.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Vader loses his weapon and is knocked out.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: Vader saves himself by retreating into the Force.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Thanos's dominance by proving the futility of Sith technique.
fight-simulation.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Force Rage
fight-simulation.s3_phase_1_event: Vader attempts to directly crush Thanos's internal organs with telekinesis.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_event: Thanos ignores the pain and drives a fist into Vader's chest plate.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_b: Thanos is burned but continues the assault.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_event: Thanos delivers the final blow, ending the match once and for all.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_a: Vader dies as a Sith Lord.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_b: Thanos walks away victorious from the slaughter.
fight-simulation.s3_end_condition: Thanos's victory through total destruction of the opponent.
fight-simulation.s4_label: Fight to the Death · No Rage
fight-simulation.s4_phase_1_event: Vader desperately tries to repel Thanos, but the Titan is unstoppable.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_event: Thanos's darkness overwhelms the Dark Side of the Force in this clash.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_a: Vader loses touch with the Force.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_event: Thanos ends Anakin Skywalker's story with a single move.
fight-simulation.s4_end_condition: Thanos dominance through absolute scale difference.

final-summary.line_1: Darth Vader possesses technique and control that could kill almost any being, but Thanos operates on a different level of physics.
final-summary.line_2: Vader's destructive opening is but a test for the Titan's durability, which he passes without much difficulty.
final-summary.line_3: This is a clash of whether lightsaber precision can find a gap in armor that has survived galactic explosions.
final-summary.quote: “Vader has a plan for the opening. Thanos has a body that usually survives that plan.”

tactical-board.lane: Vader must solve the fight fast. Thanos only needs one opening to fail.
tactical-board.subtitle: Sith Lord versus Titan

verdict-matrix.case_1: Thanos 8/10. Vader's fury forces him to exert himself, but the Titan's armor is built for punishment the Sith cannot repeat.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Thanos 9.5/10. Without extreme Force augmentation, Vader lacks the arguments to even slow the Titan down.
verdict-matrix.case_3: Thanos 9/10. A fight to the death rewards Thanos's durability. Even a wounded Vader cannot deliver a final blow.
verdict-matrix.case_4: Thanos 10/10. Pure execution. The scale difference between Galactic Empire technology and a cosmic Titan is too vast.

x-factor.implication: If Thanos survives the first real bypass, the fight immediately shifts onto his terms.
x-factor.mechanics: Vader can only win if the first surgical attempt truly bypasses Thanos's cosmic durability.
x-factor.psychology: Vader wants a controlled duel. Thanos wants the fight to become a long execution.
x-factor.example: Vader slashes Thanos's arm with a lightsaber. For most, it's the end, but Thanos simply grabs Vader by the throat with his other hand and strikes with planet-shattering force.
x-factor.question: Is a lightsaber even capable of cutting the skin of a Titan who survived a close encounter with a black hole?
